title: Lake at rest beside NoData: a ponded surface against NoData cells must stay still
note: Direct guard for the 2026-11-24 NoData wall bug (PR #516, Boann 6.0.0): before the fix the shock solvers drove water into NoData without limit (reached several m/s and metres of depth in 10 minutes). The shock-solver face against a NoData cell must be a reflecting wall.
